services.title: A clear position. A presence built around it.
services.intro: We help turn founder expertise into a coherent LinkedIn presence. The scope can include your profile, professional content, company story, workflows and campaigns—agreed around your buyer, evidence and priorities.

modules.title: LinkedIn profile,  search & positioning
modules.short: Make the first impression explain the business.
modules.body: Clarify who you help,  the problem you solve and why your experience matters. Align your headline,  About section,  featured work and company presence with the language your intended buyers recognize.
deliverables: Company-page message alignment and authorized Search Appearances review
modules.boundary: Profile edits and account data require approval and agreed permissions. Search position, keyword demand and ranking gains are not guaranteed.

modules.title: Content strategy
modules.short: Give every post a reason to exist.
modules.body: Connect buyer questions with the decisions,  experience and evidence inside your business. Build an editorial direction that balances product expertise,  founder perspective and a clear commercial offer.
deliverables: Buyer questions, search-language hypotheses and editorial themes
Publication format mix and content calendar
modules.boundary: Audience assumptions and priorities are hypotheses until checked against your buyer evidence.

modules.title: Professional writing & founder stories
modules.short: Sound like the person behind the product.
modules.body: Turn regular founder and expert interviews into considered LinkedIn posts,  personal stories and longer pieces. Keep your judgment, vocabulary and technical meaning intact as the writing becomes easier to read.
deliverables: Regular founder/expert interviews and source notes
modules.boundary: You approve the final meaning and factual claims. We do not invent experiences,  customer cases or results.

modules.title: Carousels,  visuals & video
modules.short: Show the idea as clearly as you explain it.
modules.body: Make complex work easier to understand through document posts,  product walkthroughs,  diagrams and short videos. Build a recognizable visual language for the founder and the company.
deliverables: Video scripts,  visual direction and reusable templates
modules.boundary: Production scope,  footage rights,  accessibility and final formats are agreed before delivery.

modules.title: Content operations & automation
modules.short: Make the process easier to keep running.
modules.body: Organize source capture,  drafts,  approvals and repurposing in a shared workflow. Automate repeatable administration where it helps,  while keeping publishing decisions with the people responsible for the account.
deliverables: Tool and handoff setup for your team
modules.boundary: Tool integrations,  subscriptions,  account permissions and publishing are separately scoped. No automated connection requests,  scraped inboxes or engagement pods are included.

modules.title: Marketing, outreach & customer conversations
modules.short: Connect the personal brand to the next useful conversation.
modules.body: Bring founder content, company messaging and campaign material into the same conversation. Develop relevant outreach starters, follow-up copy and response guidance around a defined buyer and a genuine reason to speak.
modules.boundary: Real outreach, inbox work and community actions require explicit scope and account authority. No scraped lists, bulk sending or automated relationship activity is implied.

modules.title: LinkedIn advertising
modules.short: Put a considered message behind a considered budget.
modules.body: Develop campaign angles,  creative and landing-page messages around a defined buyer and objective. Use measured tests to learn which messages deserve more investment.
deliverables: Ad copy,  creative and landing-page alignment
modules.boundary: Media buying,  tracking,  account access and campaign launch require separate approval. Ad spend and platform costs are additional. No pipeline or return is guaranteed.

modules.title: Measurement & editorial learning
modules.short: Learn which ideas matter to the right people.
modules.body: Review what was published,  who responded and what the available evidence can show. Use those observations to improve the next round of themes,  formats and distribution decisions.
modules.boundary: Reporting uses the data you authorize. Engagement,  attributed leads and revenue remain distinct measures; we do not claim causality from a simple before-and-after comparison.

services.processTitle: From source material to a presence you can stand behind.

steps.title: Understand the business
steps.body: Map the product, the buyer, the alternatives and the evidence already available. Agree the job LinkedIn should do.

steps.body: Define the perspective and message. Set the formats, workflow, permissions and measures for the engagement.

steps.title: Create and review
steps.body: Develop writing, visuals and campaign material. Check technical meaning, voice, sources and approvals together.

steps.title: Publish, learn and improve
steps.body: Use the agreed distribution process and authorized data. Review the response and choose the next test.

services.faqTitle: Clear expectations before the work begins.

faq.question: Can we start with the profile or strategy only?
faq.answer: Yes. A focused scope can establish the position, profile or editorial direction before an ongoing program. Deliverables, cadence and commercial terms are agreed for the engagement.

faq.question: What does automation cover?
faq.answer: Repeatable administration such as source organization, review routing, approved scheduling and repurposing. Specific tools, subscriptions, integrations and account permissions are agreed separately. It does not mean autonomous publishing or automated relationship activity.

faq.question: Do advertising services include the media budget?
faq.answer: Campaign strategy, creative and management scope are agreed separately. Media spend and platform costs are additional. Launch requires the account access, tracking choices and budget you approve.

faq.question: Will the writing still sound like me?
faq.answer: Your interviews, examples and feedback shape the draft. You review the voice, factual detail and technical meaning before approval.

faq.question: Can you guarantee leads or sales?
faq.answer: No. We agree the objective and measures, then report what the authorized evidence can show. Reach, qualified responses, attributed leads and revenue are different outcomes.

faq.question: Can you help with LinkedIn search and customer conversations?
faq.answer: Yes. The scope can include buyer-language research,profile and publication wording,manual outreach copy and customer-response guidance. We agree permissions and review responsibility before any account action. A particular search position,response rate or sales outcome is not guaranteed.

truthfulness.customer_evidence: No real customer testimony, account, results or metrics supplied. All review specimens must keep the visible label in every crop and export.
truthfulness.capabilities: Owner-authorized proposed offer modules, not proof of staffing, runtime integration, connected ad account or active client service.
truthfulness.pricing: Indicative package prices are in pricing.json; final scope and commercial terms are agreed together.
truthfulness.demand: Buyer demand and conversion gains unvalidated.

design_handoff.review_labels: Visible next to every email/comment and repeated within expanded modal. Never place only in a distant footer.
design_handoff.posts: Specimen labels stay in perspective cards, stack and video descriptions. Do not add follower counts, likes, client logos or fake timestamps.
design_handoff.headings: Keep full meaningful text in DOM. Animations must preserve accessible reading order and reduced-motion access.
